note: Every cell is tagged interest_rate. In the '#% (incl. #% PIK)' shape, n1 equals the interest_rate tag on all 22 rows and n2 equals the pik_rate tag on all 22 rows, so n1 is the all-in rate and n2 the PIK part. The '#% PIK' shape has one row, 9.75% PIK, where the whole rate is PIK. Its n1 matches the pik_rate tag and the interest_rate tag is absent, so I read it as a PIK rate.
